title: Faculty Info Member of the Faculty of Education Berthold Beitz Professor in Human Rights, Global Affairs and Philosophy Director of the Carr-Ryan Center for Human Rights
bio: Home Faculty Directory Mathias Risse's work primarily addresses questions of global justice ranging from human rights, inequality, taxation, trade and immigration to climate change, obligations to future generations and the future of technology, especially also the impact of artificial intelligence on a range of normative issues. He has also worked on questions in ethics, decision theory and 19th century German philosophy, especially Nietzsche. Email mathias_risse@hks.harvard.edu
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
